env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
! logos build -o $WORK/out$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/out$GOEXE
! logos build ./...
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/out$GOEXE
cd ..
mkdir $WORK/gocache-late
mkdir $WORK/tmp-late
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache-late
env TMPDIR=$WORK/tmp-late

cd late
! logos build -o $WORK/out-late$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/out-late$GOEXE
! logos build ./...
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! logos eject -o $WORK/ejectlate
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/ejectlate
! exec grep -r LateDecl $WORK/ejectlate
! exec grep -r LateDecl $WORK/gocache-late
! exec grep -r LateDecl $WORK/tmp-late
cd ..

cd ok
logos eject -o $WORK/ejectok
exists $WORK/ejectok/go.mod
logos build -o $WORK/out-ok$GOEXE ./cmd
exists $WORK/out-ok$GOEXE
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/noemit

go 1.27

-- m/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

-- m/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/noemit/c"

type Bad struct {
	N int
}

func (m *Bad) Name() string {
	m.N++
	return "bad"
}

var _ c.Namer = &Bad{}

func Msg() string {
	return "hi"
}

-- m/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/noemit/u"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(u.Msg())
}

-- late/go.mod --
module example.com/late

go 1.27

-- late/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

-- late/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/late/c"

var _ c.Namer = LateDecl{tag: "x"}

type LateDecl struct {
	tag   string
	items []int
}

func (l LateDecl) Name() string {
	l.items[0] = 1
	return "late:" + l.tag
}

func Msg() string {
	return "hi"
}

-- late/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/late/u"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(u.Msg())
}

-- ok/go.mod --
module example.com/ok

go 1.27

-- ok/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

-- ok/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/ok/c"

var _ c.Namer = LateOK{tag: "y"}

type LateOK struct {
	tag   string
	items []int
}

func (l LateOK) Name() string {
	return "late:" + l.tag
}

func Msg() string {
	return "hi"
}

-- ok/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ok/u"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(u.Msg())
}
